correctness.rationale: Normal-coordinate rescaling converts the Dakshi--Pusti kernel at radii epsilon*t to the Euclidean complex spherical mean with nonzero factor 2^(mu+1). The normalized distribution s_+^(mu-1)/Gamma(mu) extends the limit through the analytic-continuation range. An assumed global L^p maximal bound then transfers by Fatou to the Euclidean single-scale maximal operator, and the published Liu--Shen--Song--Yan necessary condition gives the stated sigma_d(p,p) region. Algebraic comparisons of the three terms and the real-hyperbolic consistency check were verified.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Dakshi--Pusti's September 2026 all-rank-one theorem gives only the real-parameter condition mu>1-d+d/p and explicitly flags the p>2 range for further investigation. Chen--Shen--Wang--Yan obtain the sharper two-term obstruction only on real hyperbolic space. Searches found no all-rank-one complex-order statement with this necessary region. The blow-up idea itself is not claimed as fundamentally new; the recent source creates a residual risk of contemporaneous unindexed coverage.

value.rationale: For every p>2 the theorem strictly improves the known necessary condition for the newly introduced general rank-one family, extends the real-hyperbolic local obstruction to complex, quaternionic and Cayley rank-one spaces, and supplies a real-part obstruction for complex order. It narrows the admissible region for any future improvement of the sufficient theory.
